product.name: Suawave
product.short: Accept stablecoin payments such as USDT through the Suawave API. An order is paid only after a signed callback verifies.
long: Suawave adds a stablecoin payment method to your store. At checkout the integration asks the Suawave API for a deposit address and shows the customer the exact amount, the address and a QR code.
The order is marked paid only when the API sends a callback whose RSA signature verifies against the public key you configured. A pending callback never pays an order.
The payout address is your own wallet. Every deposit is forwarded there. The integration uses the public API, so it needs no account and no API key.
features: Shows the deposit address, the amount, the network, the minimum deposit and a QR code to the customer.
Verifies every callback with the API public key (RSA-SHA256) before reading it.
Ignores repeated deliveries of the same callback.
Keeps the order on hold after a partial payment and adds a later deposit to the running total.
Calculates amounts as exact decimal strings, never as floating point numbers.
Has no bundled third-party code and no runtime dependencies.

faq.q: Do I need an account or an API key?
faq.a: No. The integration uses the public Suawave API, which needs no registration and no key.

faq.q: Where do I get the callback public key?
faq.a: Run `curl https://api.suawave.com/pubkey/` once and paste the `pubkey` value in the settings, turning `\n` into real line breaks.

faq.q: Can a customer pay less than the order total?
faq.a: A smaller confirmed deposit leaves the order on hold with a note. A later deposit is added to the running total, and the order is paid when the total reaches the order amount.

faq.q: Which tokens and networks are supported?
faq.a: You choose the asset and chain in the settings, for example `trc20/usdt` on TRON or `bep20/usdt` on BNB Smart Chain.

wordpress.title: Suawave Payments
wordpress.short: Accept stablecoin payments such as USDT in WooCommerce. An order is paid only after a signed callback verifies.
long: Suawave Payments adds a stablecoin payment method to WooCommerce and a small invoice API for plain WordPress. At checkout the plugin asks the Suawave API for a deposit address and shows the exact amount, the address and a QR code.
The order is marked paid only when the API sends a callback whose RSA signature verifies. A pending callback never pays an order.
The payout address is your own wallet. Every deposit is forwarded there.
features: Shows the deposit address, the amount, the network, the minimum deposit and a QR code on the thank-you page and in the order email.
Verifies every callback with the API public key (RSA-SHA256) before reading it.
Ignores repeated deliveries of the same callback.
Keeps the order on hold after a partial payment and adds a later deposit to the running total.
Calculates amounts as exact decimal strings, never as floating point numbers.
Works with WooCommerce 8 or newer and declares compatibility with HPOS (custom order tables).
Has no bundled third-party code and no runtime dependencies.

faq.q: Do I need an account or an API key?
faq.a: No. The plugin uses the public Suawave API, which needs no registration and no key.

faq.q: Where do I get the callback public key?
faq.a: Run `curl https://api.suawave.com/pubkey/` once and paste the `pubkey` value in the settings, turning `\n` into real line breaks.

faq.q: Can a customer pay less than the order total?
faq.a: A smaller confirmed deposit leaves the order on hold with a note. A later deposit is added to the running total, and the order is paid when the total reaches the order amount.
Yes. The functions `suawave_create_invoice()` and `suawave_invoice_is_paid()` create an invoice and read its state from any plugin or theme.

faq.q: Why does the callback have no nonce?
faq.a: The callback is a signed server-to-server request from the API, not a form of a logged-in user. The RSA signature in the `x-ca-signature` header authenticates it instead.

magento.title: Suawave Payment
magento.short: Accept stablecoin payments such as USDT in Magento 2. An order is paid only after a signed callback verifies.
long: Suawave Payment adds a stablecoin payment method to checkout. The customer places the order and sees the amount, a deposit address and a QR code on the success page. The customer then sends the payment from any wallet.
The order is invoiced and moves to `processing` only after the Suawave API sends a signed, confirmed callback that the module has verified.
The module uses the public Suawave API. No account, API key or shared secret is needed.

npm_js.title: @suawave/gateway-client
npm_js.short: TypeScript client for the Suawave API with callback signature verification.
long: The client creates payments, reads their state and converts amounts through the Suawave API. It verifies the RSA signature of every callback.
Every amount is a decimal string. The client rejects a number before it sends anything.
It has zero runtime dependencies and ships ESM and CommonJS builds with type declarations. It runs on Node 20 or newer and in browsers.

npm_mcp.title: @suawave/mcp
npm_mcp.short: Model Context Protocol server for the Suawave API. A launcher that installs the suawave-mcp binary.
long: The package is a launcher for the Model Context Protocol server of the Suawave API. On install it downloads the prebuilt `suawave-mcp` binary for your platform from the GitHub release and checks its SHA-256 against the release `SHA256SUMS`.
The server creates and tracks stablecoin payments, converts amounts and reads the API documentation. The merchant tools turn on when you set an API key.
